```{=typst}
// Supplemental figures render as "Figure S1" (no space) in both captions and refs.
#let suppfig-kind = "quarto-float-suppfig"
#let suppfig-num(loc) = "S" + numbering("1", ..counter(figure.where(kind: suppfig-kind)).at(loc))
// Caption label: "Figure S1: ..."
#show figure.where(kind: suppfig-kind): it => {
  show figure.caption: cap => [Figure #suppfig-num(it.location())#cap.separator#cap.body]
  it
}
// Cross-references: "Figure S1"
#show ref: it => {
  let el = it.element
  if el != none and el.func() == figure and el.kind == suppfig-kind {
    link(el.location())[Figure #suppfig-num(el.location())]
  } else {
    it
  }
}
```
